style: Elegant monochrome flat vector illustration in off-black (#151515), brushed silver (#d4d8de) and white, fine clean linework, understated, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge, no lettering); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, and a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A compact city repair shop interior: a car on a lift, a steel tool chest, a pegboard wall, soft overhead lights, polished concrete floor. Flat vector, DARK off-black overall, brushed-silver highlights, white accents, monochrome. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
